desc: Build a byte-reproducible storage-free diagnostic initramfs containing scripts/t6040-cow-repro.sh, pair it with the uninstrumented CoW control Image and default DTB, and prove the stock arm64 oops already reports logical CPU while boot logs map logical CPUs to MPIDR/MIDR. Offline only; no kernel instrumentation or hardware access. Pass = two identical initramfs builds plus exact Image/DTB/initramfs/config/System.map hashes and a zero-new-hardware-operation review for ticket 209.
